title: Mass-admissible test form isolating one lattice face
statement: Let n, N ∈ ℕ, ρ > 0, 0 < δ < 1/4 and F₀ ∈ LatticeFaceIndex n N (an n-face ρ(z + F_α) of the cubical lattice 𝓛_n(ρ) in ℝ^N). Then there is a test form ω ∈ TestFormOn univ n (a C^∞ compactly supported n-form on ℝ^N) which is mass-admissible (ω ∈ massAdmissibleOn univ n univ, i.e. tsupport ω ⊆ univ and covectorEuclideanNorm(ω(x)) ≤ 1 for all x), satisfies [[F]](ω) = latticeFaceAction ρ F ω = 0 for every face index F ≠ F₀, and satisfies (ρ(1 − 2δ))^n ≤ [[F₀]](ω).
lean_statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (ρ δ : ℝ) (F₀ : LatticeFaceIndex n N), 0 < ρ → 0 < δ → δ < 1 / 4 → ∃ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) n, ω ∈ massAdmissibleOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) n univ ∧ (∀ F : LatticeFaceIndex n N, F ≠ F₀ → latticeFaceAction ρ F (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl N) n) = 0) ∧ (ρ * (1 - 2 * δ)) ^ n ≤ latticeFaceAction ρ F₀ (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl N) n)
